title: Study on the structural, optical, vibrational and dielectric properties of Cr2+-doped SnFe2O4 spinel ferrites
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37050-37061
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05190H, Paper
Open Access

Abid Zaman, Asad Ali, Hifsa Shahid, Salhah Hamed Alrefaee, Salah Knani, Vineet Tirth, Ali Algahtani, Noureddine Elboughdiri
Herein, we have examined the effects of Cr2+ doping on the structural, optical, microstructural, and dielectric properties of SnFe2O4 spinel ferrites prepared by the conventional solid-state route.
